## Primary CV
NAME: Roberto Hernan Voto
ROLE: Senior Business Analyst / Technical Business Analyst / Scrum Master
LOCATION: Australia
EXPERIENCE: 20+ years in IT

TOOLS (AUTHORITATIVE LIST)
The following tools are explicitly used by Rob Voto:
- Jira
- Azure DevOps
- Trello
- Confluence
- Enterprise Architect
- BPMN 2.0
- Visio
- Miro
- Postman
- SQL
- Power BI (basic)
- AWS (solution context)
- AI (prompt engineering and LLM-assisted analysis)
- Draw.io
- Java
- Azure
- Agile Scrum & Kanban
- REST APIs (conceptual)
- High-level business rules and decision logic

====================================
EMPLOYMENT HISTORY
====================================

Department of Employment and Workplace Relations (DEWR) - Industry: Federal Government
Senior Business Analyst - Payments
Dec 2024 - Present

- Senior BA on a large-scale payments transformation and migration program for Disability Employment Services (DES), supporting transition from DES5 to DES6.
- Analysed and modelled complex provider payment and derived-payment processes, including eligibility checks, rule sequencing, adjustments, exceptions, and system hand-offs.
- Translated policy intent into system-ready functional definitions, covering decision logic, calculation sequencing, data mappings, and edge cases.
- Produced BPMN 2.0 AS-IS and TO-BE process models used by policy, development, testing, and data teams to align on payment behaviour.
- Performed SQL-based data validation and reconciliation to compare legacy and new-system payment outcomes and support defect investigation.
- Defined detailed acceptance criteria and test scenarios to validate payment accuracy and compliance during migration.
- Tools: Azure DevOps, Enterprise Architect, SQL, BPMN, Agile Scrum.

Australian Bureau of Statistics (ABS)
Senior Business Analyst (EL1)
Apr 2024 - Dec 2024

- Senior BA on a national web-based business data collection and reporting platform.
- Analysed end-to-end workflows for capturing income, expense, and inventory data from Australian businesses.
- Designed BPMN AS-IS and TO-BE process models describing data submission, validation, processing, and downstream reporting flows.
- Clarified interactions between the web application, validation services, APIs, and backend data stores to support development and testing.
- Supported API definition and performed API testing and validation using Postman.
- Used SQL extensively for data analysis, validation, and issue investigation.
- Tools: Jira, SQL, Postman, BPMN, Agile Scrum.

NSW eHealth
Digital & Infrastructure Business Analyst / Project Coordinator
May 2022 - Nov 2023

- Lead Business Analyst across major digital and infrastructure programs within NSW Health.
- Played a key role in the transition of the NSW Health networking ecosystem to a Secure Service Edge (SSE) architecture across 15+ Local Health Districts.
- Coordinated requirements, risks, schedules, and delivery across multiple vendors, engineers, and LHD stakeholders.
- Acted as primary BA on NSW Ambulance initiatives, including infrastructure upgrades and operational support processes.
- Conducted extensive BPMN 2.0 process modelling for IT Support (including P1/P2 incidents), Procurement, Finance, and operational workflows.
- Facilitated discovery and validation workshops with eHealth IT managers and NSW Ambulance stakeholders.
- Produced AS-IS and TO-BE process models used for stakeholder alignment, onboarding, and operational documentation.
- Tools: Azure DevOps, Jira, BPMN, infrastructure platforms (networking, security), Agile Scrum.

Department of Health (Federal)
Digital Business Analyst
Jul 2021 - May 2022

- Digital BA on a federal aged care financial management and reporting platform supporting subsidised aged care and transition care services.
- Analysed and defined end-to-end accounting, data capture, and reporting workflows, including provider submissions, validation, and government reporting.
- Worked on Annual Accountability Reporting (AAR) requirements for the Transition Care Programme, covering both government and private aged-care providers.
- Produced functional and non-functional requirements to support financial transparency, compliance, and auditability.
- Facilitated stakeholder workshops with policy teams, delivery teams, and external providers to clarify requirements and reporting obligations.
- Supported delivery and testing activities until the program reached approximately 75% implementation before cancellation for external reasons.
- Tools: Azure DevOps, SQL, BPMN, Agile Scrum.

Phoenix DX
Agile Business Analyst / Consultant
May 2020 - Jul 2021

- Agile BA and consultant in a low-code delivery environment (OutSystems).
- Led discovery, requirements definition, and Agile delivery for multiple client solutions.
- Strong use of Gherkin BDD (GIVEN / WHEN / THEN) for acceptance criteria.
- BPMN modelling for process improvement and workflow optimisation.
- Involvement in API integrations and system-to-system workflows.
- Tools and platforms: OutSystems, Jira, BPMN, Gherkin BDD, Postman, Agile Scrum & Kanban.

Rockstar Coders (USA)
Business Analyst / Scrum Master / Delivery Manager
2018 - 2020

- Senior BA / SM / Delivery Manager for a US-based digital agency.
- Worked across dozens of mobile and web products for international clients.
- Led discovery workshops, UX definition, requirements, and delivery planning.
- Produced BPMN and Visio process models for business process improvement.
- Acted as primary client-facing delivery lead across multiple accounts.
- Tools: Trello, BPMN, Visio, Miro, UX artefacts, Agile Scrum & Kanban.

Globant
Digital Business Analyst / Consultant
2016 - 2018

- Digital BA on enterprise platforms for major global clients.
- Worked on large-scale digital solutions for Mastercard and Google.
- Requirements analysis, stakeholder engagement, and delivery support.
- Involvement in web platforms, integrations, and cloud-based solutions.
- Tools and practices included Jira, BPMN, API documentation, and cloud-based delivery environments.

Frucor Suntory
Functional & Data Analyst
2015 - 2016

- Functional and data BA on an end-to-end order-to-cash integration program.
- SAP and EDI-based integrations with major customers (e.g. Woolworths, Domino’s).
- Data mapping, validation, and coordination across business and technical teams.
- Tools: SAP, EDI, SQL, data mapping specifications.

Adaptra Consulting
Business Analyst
2010 - 2012

- Business Analyst and Functional Consultant specialising in Guidewire platforms.
- Configuration, requirements definition, and pre-sales solution design.
- Involvement in insurance system integrations and solution architecture.
- Tools: Guidewire, BPMN, integration specifications.

NSW Department of Education
Senior Analyst Developer
2007 - 2010

- Senior Analyst Developer in education systems.
- Java development and enterprise system integration.
- Extensive work on SOAP / SOA integrations and backend services.
- Tools: Java, SOAP/SOA, SQL, enterprise integration frameworks.

NSW Department of Education
Technical / Functional Business Analyst
2012 - 2015

- Technical and Functional BA on large-scale, state-wide education platforms supporting 2,200+ NSW public schools.
- Worked on major programs including LMBR and ICC, involving system integration, ETL, and large-scale data migration.
- Performed heavy SQL-based analysis to define data mappings, transformation rules, and validation logic.
- Modelled BPMN processes and integration workflows covering student enrolment, residency and visa management, and sensitive legal and family information.
- Supported multi-million-dollar enterprise programs involving multiple legacy systems and vendors.
- Tools: SQL, BPMN, ETL tooling, enterprise education platforms.

Mastercard (Argentina)
Technical Business Analyst / Senior Analyst Developer
2002 - 2006

- Technical BA and developer on enterprise financial systems.
- Development and integration of Mastercard client-facing platforms.
- Java / J2EE development and middleware integration.
- Tools: Java/J2EE, middleware, SQL.

Movistar
Analyst Developer
2002 - 2004

- Analyst Developer role in telecommunications systems.
- Tools: Java, enterprise telecom platforms.

====================================
EDUCATION
====================================

- Bachelor’s Degree (completed)

====================================
CERTIFICATIONS
====================================

- Certified Scrum Master (CSM)
- Certified Associate in Project Management (CAPM)
- BPMN 2.0 Business Process Modelling
- OutSystems Associate Reactive Developer
- Guidewire Certification
